seoTitle: Number to Words in English, French, German, Dutch and Spanish
metaDescription: Spell numbers in words in five languages, with euro, dollar and pound formats for cheques and contracts. Free, offline.
intro: Writes numbers out in words in English, French, German, Dutch and Spanish, with an optional currency format.
why:
Cheques and contracts often need the amount in words. Rules differ by language: French 80 is quatre-vingts, German writes numbers as one word, Spanish says veintiun mil.

Enter one number per line and pick a language and currency. It was compared with the num2words library on 71 numbers; the differences were library quirks (Dutch accent on een, German einhunderteinstausend, Spanish uno before mil). The Dutch one-word rule was not checked against the Taalunie.
howTo: Pick a currency format if needed.

faq.q: How large a number can it write?

faq.a: With a currency set, up to two decimal places, rounded half up.

faq.q: Does it cover Belgian or Swiss variants?
